name: Yanagi Yuuji
source:
Aiji's older brother. He's a high-society man who works for a very prominent company and possesses an arrogant attitude. He has had a strained relationship with his younger brother since they were in school, but ever since Aiji became a police officer, he has pretty much broken off all communication with him.

[From the [url=http://www.aksysgames.com/unlimited/characters/]official English website[/url]]
